big_case.notes: Pro se paid petition by one former spouse against the other, seeking review of an unpublished Washington Court of Appeals decision affirming a civil protection order under RCW 7.105; state supreme court denied review. The question presented is nominally sweeping (due process, Second Amendment, Supremacy Clause, bill of attainder, 18 U.S.C. 922(g)(8) and 2265) but the vehicle is a private family dispute with no alleged split and no reasoned published opinion below. Realized outcome: silent denial at the long conference, no writing. Stakes as a case the Court could decide were very low.
